note: Each mutant file judged in the tree its pass was recorded in (register decision 255). The mutants take one case of judging_tree away each -- the recorded tree ignored, made-up changes sent to the recorded tree, a recorded tree that is not here judged anyway -- and are judged by the self-test, which holds each case. Not a mutant here: main_check's use of the chosen tree, which only a real record exercises; it was measured instead on 2026-10-02, the same nine files listed due whichever tree was named. Since M1-109 (register decision 392) a Python mutant names no build target, and the harness builds nothing for it; until then every mutant named orbsim_shaders as a no-op, which made every shader an input of this file.
